Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning small-scale ocean beach prospecting and mining.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to small-scale ocean beach prospecting and mining;adding a new section to chapter 77.55 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The completion of a twoyear pilot programmandated by chapter 83, Laws of 2008 determined that small-scale oceanbeach prospecting and mining poses no identifiable threat to fish,their habitats, or conflicts with other beach users. As a result, theWashington state parks and recreation commission adopted new rules forbeach prospecting that became effective October 2011. The rules allowfor prospecting and mining year-round with limited types of smallhand-operated and motorized equipment on certain ocean beaches withinthe seashore conservation area without a permit.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All ocean beach prospecting and mining activity is exempt from therequirements of this chapter provided the activity complies with the p. 1 SB 6132provisions of WAC 352-37-340 as existing on the effective date of thissection.
